profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Solutions Architect | Enterprise Systems | Java | Kafka | Data Architecture

Experienced Solutions Architect with deep expertise in designing, building, and maintaining enterprise applications across complex environments. I specialize in modernizing legacy systems, leading cross-functional teams, and delivering scalable solutions aligned with business strategy.

Skilled in:

Java/Spring-based architectures

Kafka (enterprise-level fault tolerance + disaster recovery)

Data modeling and architecture (Oracle, MongoDB, SQL Server, Apache Solr)

System integration (APIs, microservices, event-driven design)

Agile/Scrum leadership and solution delivery

I bring a hands-on, technically grounded approach to architecture — balancing long-term maintainability with short-term delivery. I’ve led large initiatives involving cloud migrations, data pipeline refactors, and platform decoupling from legacy dependencies. I thrive in complex, fast-moving environments and focus on clear communication between technical and business teams.

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description: Experienced Solutions Architect with a proven track record of successfully leading organizations through complex technology transitions. Specializing in Java ecosystems, I bring expertise in guiding seamless migrations from legacy versions of Java and Spring Boot frameworks. My mission is to architect robust and scalable solutions that align with organizational goals, enhance performance, and ensure future-proofing.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Database Design · Solution Architecture · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Lead System Architect
positions.description: Developed high-level concepts and designs for software applications. Extracted data from 30 applications (including multiple legacy apps) as well as worked on four major systems.  The most recent system has 60+ microservices, 27K lines of Drools rules and 400K lines of code. Grew system information containing customer, quote, inventory, proposal, and sales. Managed software developers through the coding process. Wrote applications, imported/normalized data objects, and software requirement specification documents. Collaborated with the Project Manager to set and stick to the timeline. Oversaw day-to-day work for operations and reporting.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Application Development · Software Design · MongoDB · Maven · IntelliJ IDEA · Postman API · Linux · Database Design · Java · DevOps · Apache Kafka · Data Analysis · Jira · Splunk · Oracle Database · GitHub · Oracle SQL Developer · Log4j · Agile Methodologies · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Solr · Software Testing · Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) · Communication · Software Deployment

positions.title: Software Engineer Principal
positions.description: Supported an old 2-tiered application that imported data from legacy systems; used stored procedures and SSIS jobs that updated data every 4 to 24 hours.  Built an application that transformed order data for an operations user interface using Drools. Designed an application that updated Solr indexes in near real time to provide the ability to quickly search and return items. Generated original order and workflow data into tables via Oracle database.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Application Development · Software Design · Database Design · Java · Visual Studio · DevOps · Apache Kafka · Data Analysis · Jira · Log4j · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) · Software Testing · Drools · Tomcat · Microsoft SQL Server · Communication · Software Deployment

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developed software in a Java web application that used the Spring Framework and Hibernate, and JDBC to load and manipulate data in a large Oracle Database.  This application used both Apache Tomcat and Glassfish at different times over 3 years.  I was primarily responsible for the file parsers that used XML for configuration and for parsing EDI files. Supported the Data Warehouse – designed database tables, developed PL/SQL code, used SQL to troubleshoot, and provided operations support.
